page.overview:
What is Hearthome City?

Hearthome City is a location introduced in Generation IV.

Hearthome City is a large city in the Sinnoh region and the fifth largest city in the Pokémon World at large. Hearthome City is an elegant city and the most desirable location to live at in Sinnoh. It is designed to be accessible to younger children, which is why several buildings in Hearthome City use elevators instead of stairs. The games also feature the fifth Gym Leader, Fantina, who specializes in -type Pokémon.

In the core series, Hearthome City is the only location in Sinnoh focused on Pokémon Super Contests, the successor to the Pokémon Contests held in Hoenn. It is also where Furthermore, it has a building where Poffins are made, and they can increase a Pokémon's conditions for contests.

In and its remakes , there is a Hiker near the southeast entrance who gives the player a Happiny Pokémon Egg if talked to; this does not occur in .
